Usually yes, and it depends on what kind of tired. If you're a bit flat from a long day or a so-so night of sleep, show up and start your warm-up. Plenty of good sessions come out of a sluggish first set. A reasonable test is to give it 10 to 15 minutes, and if the weights are moving ok, carry on.

If it's a run of bad sleep or you've been dragging for days, keep the session but pull it back: fewer sets, a lighter load, or leave a couple more reps in the tank than usual. A shorter session beats skipping and beats grinding through a heavy one at half capacity.

If you're feeling unwell, that's a different thing, and one for a doctor rather than me.

Want me to set up a lighter session for today?
